title: Six Boxes
lines: Meg and Mom packed six boxes.
The first box had dishes and cups.
The next box had peaches and buns.
The last box had a big lid on top.
Meg lifted it. Foxes ran out!
Mom had to catch them in a net.
Now Meg looks in the boxes first.

questions.ask: What was in the first box?
questions.listenFor: Dishes and cups. If they guess, have them reread that line.

questions.ask: What jumped out of the last box?
questions.listenFor: Foxes. Listen for the -es ending - that is this lesson.

questions.ask: Will Meg lift a lid like that again? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer. Listen for a reason from the last line.
